objective.name: sandbox.dsl.remote.wrapper
objective.description: Cross-instance DSL flow invoking a remote wrapper-backed capacity directly.

#root.role: Perform a local engine-native state read, then invoke a remote wrapper-backed capacity directly through the external Brique boundary.

effects.local_engine_route: A local engine-native reflexive call is awaited.
effects.external_route: A remote wrapper-backed route crosses the inter-instance boundary.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one remote wrapper-backed terminal response after a local state read and a direct inter-instance wrapper route.
invariants: The flow always performs one local read.state before the remote wrapper call.
The terminal payload is the payload returned by the remote wrapper-backed sandbox.echo invocation.
Only one direct inter-instance wrapper route is issued.
success: On success, the terminal payload is the payload returned by the remote sandbox.echo capacity.
Successful execution proves that a local engine-native step can precede a remote wrapper-backed terminal route.
failure: The flow fails if the local read.state step or the remote wrapper route cannot complete.
Inter-instance wrapper routing errors close the capacity fail-closed.
notes: This scenario validates direct remote wrapper composition from a DSL plan.
The local read.state result is a routing prerequisite but not the terminal payload.
